attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion where the human anatomy becomes a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body. Preserve the real source hair: strongly receding bare upper crown with very short grey-brown side and temple hair, and real brow hair. Maintain the serious closed-mouth expression and slight head roll. Do not invent a separate moustache; keep the smooth chin and exact source upper-lip appearance. The outfit is a dark navy/black open-lapel suit with subtle source-visible pinstripe hints, a pale white shirt, and a dark tie at the lower center beside the note. No cap or spectacles. The rounded chin must immediately meet the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque grey backing, and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories. Fine primary details that are indistinct in the source must stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded slightly angled serious CLOSED-MOUTH bust. Strongly receding/bare upper crown with very short GREY-BROWN side/temple hair and real brow HAIR, smooth chin and no distinct separate moustache. Dark navy/black OPEN-lapel suit with subtle source-visible pinstripe hints, pale WHITE shirt and DARK tie at lower center beside note. No cap or spectacles, preserve slight source expression/head roll and light. Fine tie texture understated, no invented medals.
Mascot eyes must be green-ringed black eyes. Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
